label: M37_mode7_standard_low_v1
_note: M37 mode 7 target (v1, 2026-04-24) — standard (low-hit) variant.
No feature engine → target covers full 85% total RTP.
Design brief (MODE_DESIGN.md §5-8 + project_slot_designer_hit_rate_deviation.md):
- RTP 85% ±1pp (strict — standard mode)
- Hit ~9.9% (mode 1 was 15.2%; Low bucket absolute hit cut, Mid/High/Top absolute unchanged)
- Bucket shape:
Low  (ge1_lt5 + ge5_lt10): Low hit cut ~45% from mode 1 (× 0.5 / × 0.6)
Mid  (ge10_lt20 + ge20_lt50): absolute hit = mode 1
High (ge50_lt100 + ge100_lt200 + ge200_lt500): absolute hit = mode 1
Top  (ge500+): absolute hit = mode 1
Relationship to mode 1:
mode 1: 95% / hit 15.2% → per-hit ~6.3×
mode 7: 85% / hit 9.9% → per-hit ~8.6× (mid/high 占比相对升)
Player feel: 小奖少 grind 感重，但 mid/big win 跟 mode 1 一样
(mode 7 = mode 1 最后一档奖的记忆点保留，chase 感弱化)
Strips byte-identical to mode 1 (tune with --sa-steps 0).
No trigger target (M37 has no feature).
Target bucket rates derived from mode 1 ACTUAL tuned bucket rates
(not mode 1 target rates) — preserves what mode 1 actually shipped
so player-visible Mid/High/Top frequencies are consistent across modes.

_design_constraints.variance_target: base cv ~7-8 (higher than mode 1's 6.7 due to lower hit flattening the per-hit distribution upward)

derivation_from_mode_1.rule: Low bucket absolute hit cut; Mid/High/Top absolute hit preserved (mode 1 actual post-tune bucket rates)
